about: The non-pet parts of the Herd Web (herd-web-20261012.html): AI models, infrastructure, programs, computers and roadmap pets, plus links that cannot live in pets.json relations because one end is not a pet with a repo. Pet-to-pet links stay in pets.json relations. @pets means every registered and pipeline pet; @seeds and @roadmap mean every seed and every roadmap pet. Links to @pets are herd-wide and drawn behind their own toggle. Built by scripts/herd-web-20261012.mjs during npm run build. Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), 2026-10-12.

states.planned: Planned (decided, or in a pet's own job)

carries.builds: code and changes made by an assistant on a branch, from a handoff card
carries.opens: opens or controls a real program
carries.model: requests to an AI model and its replies
carries.manages: looks after a real program or world: health, updates, planned work

nodes.name: The Farm
nodes.job: The responsive website with a card and an always-visible text box for every pet, on any device. Replaces the Cage (ASTRA_PET_OS section 4).

nodes.name: The Kennel
nodes.job: astras-kennel: the community pet catalog. Developers submit a link to their own repo; review, security checks and adoption happen here. Does not exist yet (ASTRA_PET_OS, Kennel).

nodes.name: Program Manager
nodes.job: Neutral registry of every real program: links, launchers, status and capabilities, for every pet including the Farmer (ASTRA_PET_OS section 6).

nodes.name: Agent harness
nodes.job: Shared plumbing under every pet agent: model adapters (Claude, OpenAI, local), tools, skills, memory, permission checks and audit (ASTRA_PET_OS section 8). Every pet agent calls models through it.

nodes.name: Desktop host and tray Star
nodes.job: The Windows tray Star and the desktop pets that roam your real desktop. Reads pets.json and the art index (scripts/desktop-pets-20261011.cs). Hiding it never stops a pet working.
